title: Fish Scales
description: A flank of overlapping fish scales, drawn as imbricated rows where each scale laps the one below and alternate rows offset by half. A species preset sets both the palette and the pattern painted across the body — koi kohaku patches, rainbow-trout spots and pink band, wavy mackerel bars over a steely back, goldfish sheen, or a tropical rainbow — while a travelling iridescent highlight shimmers over everything as the fish turns in the light. Scale size, roundness, iridescence, shimmer speed and pattern strength are live; shimmer and iridescence are audio-mappable and beats ripple down the flank.
